why: Argo, shutterflow desktop-v3 and the gallery cutover run a second basalt install next to a live one. concept migration-release 6.1 marks the CLI behaviour for that as unbuilt (U), and no G0-G4 Issue builds it: without it argo's root `sync --check` exits 1 on two Vite packages and a lead would hand-write or rename generated files.
what: The temporary `basalt.sibling` package key: resolver branch, app-scoped `init --profile app` and `sync`, the basalt-v3-* name prefix, placement skips, fixtures and tests. Stays in 3.0.0: argo and shutterflow run their second install after publish; removal belongs to the held cutover re-cut. Paths are under packages/basalt-ui/.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1 (the table is the spec) and exception 6 (temporary), 9.2 (an undeclared second install is still refused). F fixture: a repo root with `"basalt": {"app": "apps/x"}` and a second app `apps/x-v3` declaring `"basalt": {"sibling": true}`, each with its own basalt-ui copy.
exemplar: src/cli/sync tests (v3-sk-2) for render-and-compare fixtures; src/cli/init tests (v3-sk-3) for profile output.
change: Resolver: root `basalt.app` names the root-owned install, an app with `basalt.sibling` is a declared second install, any other second install is refused as before. `init --profile app` run in the app dir writes the app's .basalt/manifest.json, .oxlintrc.json extending the generated preset and AGENTS.md block; its rules go to the repo root as `.claude/rules/basalt-v3-*.md` with the app's rendered `paths:`, its skills as `.claude/skills/basalt-v3-<name>/`; when the repo already holds another sibling's basalt-v3-* files (shutterflow has apps/gallery and apps/desktop-v3) the names become `basalt-v3-<dirname>-*`; below the repo root it skips lefthook and check.yml and says so (two placement skips); it registers no hook at the root. Root `sync` and `sync --check` leave every `basalt-v3-*` name alone (no prune, no drift). The app's own bin `sync --check` and `doctor` exit 0. Rule: none new; the resolver refusal is the guard. Skill snippet: none. Tests: the fixture cases below.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution; make sync-self its own commit.
proof: `bun test packages/basalt-ui/src/cli` on the fixture; counts of written and skipped files printed by the test.
acceptance: in the fixture, root `sync --check` exits 1 with neither key declared and exits 0 with both declared

`init --profile app` in apps/x-v3 creates .basalt/manifest.json, .oxlintrc.json, AGENTS.md there and at the root only `basalt-v3-*` rules and skills; no root .basalt/ or .oxlintrc.json changes (git diff)
it prints exactly two placement skips (lefthook, check.yml) and registers no hook in the root .claude/settings.json
root `sync --check` after the init exits 0 and does not delete or rewrite any basalt-v3-* file
an undeclared third install is still refused with the existing message
a second sibling in the same fixture gets `basalt-v3-<dirname>-*` names and neither app's files are overwritten
out_of_scope: Consumer repos, its removal, cutover renames, new profiles, hook placement.
